coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary:
Elbow Not Rising and Moving Forward in Backswing; Excessive Backswing Magnitude; Insufficient Non-Racket (Left) Leg Loading; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your backswing you stay almost upright instead of hinging forward from the hips. Keep your chest angled a little more over your front knee when you draw the racket arm back. That forward lean helps you load your legs and core so you can drive into the shuttle on the next phase. During your forward-swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten toward full extension just before contact. Work on allowing the arm to lengthen so the hand finishes farther away from your shoulder. This extra reach lets you meet the shuttle earlier and maintain a smoother acceleration path. From your very first move you hold the hitting arm’s forearm and grip muscles at a high, steady effort instead of letting them stay relaxed and then spike just before contact. That early tension shows up during preparation and carries right through the backswing, so the racket never gets the free-swinging acceleration you want. Think of keeping the hand loose until you start the forward swing, then squeeze at the last instant. Right after you finish the hit, your eyes sweep well past the contact area—first jumping out to your right and slightly upward, then diving low—rather than settling quickly. This extra scan happens in the follow-through and can make it harder for you to keep your head steady and re-orient for the next shot.

Lift your elbow higher during the take-back so it lines up with your shoulder before the forward swing. Hinge at the hips so your chest is over your front knee as you take the racket back. Let the hitting arm straighten fully toward the shuttle just before contact. Keep your grip loose during the set-up, squeeze only at the moment of impact. After contact, let your gaze settle instead of scanning—keep it calmly centred for a split-second before tracking the next play. Shift more body weight onto your left (non-racket) foot at the end of the backswing.

The bilateral comparison shows far more load on the right side during these late-backswing images.
visual_reviews.expert_comparison: In the expert’s corresponding backswing frames (upper row, F29–F33), the left foot is greener/warmer than the right, indicating the expected 60-75 % load shift. The beginner’s pattern is the inverse, confirming the deterministic finding.
visual_reviews.rationale: The rule requires evidence that left-foot pressure stays below 55 % (and right above 30 %) in late backswing. The colour-scale indications clearly show left foot bearing visibly less load than the right in the relevant frames, directly aligning with the stated deficit.
limitations: Colour scale is qualitative; exact percentage cannot be measured from the static image alone.
Phase boundaries ("late backswing") are inferred from frame labels, which may carry slight timing uncertainty.

visual_reviews.observed_evidence: Across the sampled forward-swing frames (player frames 38–45) the right foot is always rendered on or very near the floor, but the mesh resolution does not reliably show the instants of lift-off or landing, nor any clear vertical motion or impact deceleration. No pressure-sensor or velocity traces are provided, only static meshes at ~0.11 s intervals.
visual_reviews.expert_comparison: The expert sequence shows a relatively fixed right-foot plant before contact, but without time-resolved force or velocity data the exact landing instant is not visible. The visual similarity or difference cannot pinpoint whether the player’s right foot was airborne or already planted at frame 39 (contact).
visual_reviews.rationale: The deterministic rule requires knowing the temporal order between (a) right-foot ground-contact landing and (b) shuttle contact. Static 3-D meshes sampled at 0.11 s spacing do not resolve the precise timing of foot impact versus shuttle contact. Therefore the images neither confirm that the foot lands at/after contact nor show it was planted before contact.
limitations: Sparse frame sampling (≈0.11 s) obscures fast events such as foot strike and shuttle contact.
No insole-pressure or ankle velocity data supplied, so ground-contact timing cannot be verified.
Mesh contact with floor is visually ambiguous due to rendering discretisation.

visual_reviews.observed_evidence: In the time-series plot, the player’s gaze X (blue) begins to shift steadily away from the contact frame (purple vertical line) within roughly 10–15 frames and shows clear excursions up to ~0.3–0.4 coordinate units by frame ~65. The gaze–trajectory plot also shows the post-contact segment (beyond the red contact marker) moving outward by roughly 0.3–0.5 coordinate units from the contact point, tracing a sizeable path rather than clustering near (0,0).
visual_reviews.expert_comparison: The expert (green dashed) shows a shorter path after its contact, but both traces display noticeable post-contact movement; there is no clear period where the player’s gaze is locked with negligible displacement relative to the contact zone.
visual_reviews.rationale: The rule defines a freeze as <0.02 velocity and <0.12 distance for >200 ms. The visualised gaze quickly departs the contact location and continues to move, indicating neither minimal displacement nor sustained low velocity. This conflicts with the deterministic claim of a prolonged fixation freeze.
limitations: Exact velocity values per frame are not annotated; timing is estimated visually.
Plots mix pre- and post-contact samples, requiring inference about segment boundaries.
The coordinate system’s scale is unit-unspecified, so displacement is approximate.

zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在時間序列圖中，球員的注視X（藍色）在大約10–15幀內開始穩定地遠離接觸幀（紫色垂直線），並在大約第65幀顯示出明顯的偏移，達到約0.3–0.4坐標單位。注視軌跡圖也顯示接觸後的部分（紅色接觸標記之後）從接觸點向外移動約0.3–0.5坐標單位，描繪出一條明顯的路徑，而不是聚集在（0,0）附近。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家（綠色虛線）在接觸後顯示出較短的路徑，但兩條軌跡都顯示出明顯的接觸後移動；沒有明顯的時期顯示球員的注視被鎖定在接觸區域附近且位移可忽略不計。
zh_Hant.rationale: 規則定義了僵住為速度<0.02且距離<0.12，持續時間>200毫秒。可視化的注視快速離開接觸位置並持續移動，表明既沒有最小位移也沒有持續低速，這與長時間固定僵住的確定性說法相矛盾。

limitations.0: 每幀的精確速度值未被註解；時間是通過視覺估算的。

limitations.2: 坐標系統的比例未指定單位，因此位移是近似值。

zh_Hant.summary:
後擺時手肘未上升且未向前移動；後擺幅度過大；非持拍（左）腿承重不足；持拍腳在擊球時或之後才落地——未能實現邁步擊球；擊球時持拍腳重心偏向腳跟；擊球後視線停留過久。

在後擺時，你的身體幾乎保持直立，而不是從髖部向前傾。當你將持拍手臂向後拉時，保持胸部稍微向前膝蓋傾斜。這種向前的傾斜有助於你加載腿部和核心力量，以便在下一階段能更有力地擊球。在前揮時，你的持拍手臂肘部明顯彎曲，而不是在擊球前讓其伸直至接近完全伸展。練習讓手臂延長，這樣手可以在肩膀更遠的地方完成揮拍。這樣的額外伸展可以讓你更早地接觸到球並保持更平滑的加速路徑。從一開始，你就將持拍手臂的前臂和握拍肌肉保持在高強度的穩定狀態，而不是讓它們保持放鬆，然後在擊球前一刻才用力。這種早期的緊張狀態在準備過程中就已經出現，並一直延續到後擺，因此球拍無法獲得你想要的自由加速。試著在準備階段保持手部放鬆，然後在最後一刻用力握緊。擊球後，你的視線迅速越過擊球區域——先向右側稍微向上跳動，然後向下掃視——而不是迅速穩定下來。這種額外的掃視發生在隨揮過程中，可能會讓你更難保持頭部穩定並重新定位以迎接下一次擊球。

在後擺時將手肘抬高，使其在前揮前與肩膀對齊。從髖部彎曲，讓胸部位於前膝蓋上方，然後將球拍向後拉。讓持拍手臂在擊球前完全伸直指向球。準備時保持握拍放鬆，僅在擊球瞬間用力握緊。擊球後，讓視線穩定下來，而不是四處掃視——在追蹤下一次擊球前，讓視線平靜地集中一瞬間。在後擺結束時，將更多的體重轉移到左（非持拍）腳上。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary:
Elbow Not Rising and Moving Forward in Backswing; Excessive Backswing Magnitude; Insufficient Non-Racket (Left) Leg Loading; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your backswing you stay almost upright instead of hinging forward from the hips. Keep your chest angled a little more over your front knee when you draw the racket arm back. That forward lean helps you load your legs and core so you can drive into the shuttle on the next phase. During your forward-swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten toward full extension just before contact. Work on allowing the arm to lengthen so the hand finishes farther away from your shoulder. This extra reach lets you meet the shuttle earlier and maintain a smoother acceleration path. From your very first move you hold the hitting arm’s forearm and grip muscles at a high, steady effort instead of letting them stay relaxed and then spike just before contact. That early tension shows up during preparation and carries right through the backswing, so the racket never gets the free-swinging acceleration you want. Think of keeping the hand loose until you start the forward swing, then squeeze at the last instant. Right after you finish the hit, your eyes sweep well past the contact area—first jumping out to your right and slightly upward, then diving low—rather than settling quickly. This extra scan happens in the follow-through and can make it harder for you to keep your head steady and re-orient for the next shot.

Lift your elbow higher during the take-back so it lines up with your shoulder before the forward swing. Hinge at the hips so your chest is over your front knee as you take the racket back. Let the hitting arm straighten fully toward the shuttle just before contact. Keep your grip loose during the set-up, squeeze only at the moment of impact. After contact, let your gaze settle instead of scanning—keep it calmly centred for a split-second before tracking the next play. Shift more body weight onto your left (non-racket) foot at the end of the backswing.

The visual gap between your head/shoulders and an imaginary vertical line through your hips is noticeably smaller than in the expert’s pose.

zh_Hant.name: 你的上半身過於直立
zh_Hant.details: 後擺時，你的身體幾乎保持直立，沒有從髖部向前傾。球拍向後移動時，讓胸口稍微移至前膝上方；這能幫助腿部和核心蓄力，再把身體力量帶入擊球。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在所有六個取樣的後擺幀中（例如，第3、6、10、13、17、20幀），你的頭部、肩膀和臀部幾乎垂直堆疊，而專家的肩膀明顯在臀部前方，且軀幹向前傾斜。你的後腿也保持在你身體下方更多，表明髖部前傾較少。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家始終顯示出明顯的前傾，大約是身高的三分之一，後腳伸展且腳跟抬起。在相同編號的幀中，你的軀幹更加直立，且你的重心似乎保持在中心，而不是向前移動。你的頭部/肩膀與通過臀部的假想垂直線之間的視覺差距明顯小於專家的姿勢。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your racket arm remains too bent at contact
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: As you swing forward, your racket-side elbow stays noticeably bent instead of opening toward contact. Let the arm lengthen in the final part of the swing so you meet the shuttle farther in front, with a smoother and longer acceleration path.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across player frames 3/9 to 9/9 your right elbow angle stays visibly closed (roughly a right angle), with the forearm pointing downward. In the matching expert frames (5/14 to 14/14) the expert’s right arm is almost straight, with the hand well forward of the shoulder line. The difference is consistent through the whole sampled forward-swing sequence.
additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert progressively drives the hand forward, reaching a near-straight line from shoulder to wrist, whereas your hand remains close to your torso and the elbow never fully opens. This shows the expert using the full lever length for reach and smooth power, while your shorter lever limits contact point and follow-through.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時，你的持拍手臂仍然過度彎曲
zh_Hant.details: 前揮時，你的持拍側手肘仍明顯彎曲，未能在接近觸球時伸展。請在揮拍最後階段把手臂延長，讓你能在身體更前方迎擊羽毛球，並形成更順暢、更長的加速路徑。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員幀3/9到9/9中，你的右肘角度保持明顯閉合（大約直角），前臂指向下方。在匹配的專家幀（5/14到14/14）中，專家的右臂幾乎伸直，手明顯在肩線前方。這種差異在整個取樣的前擺動作序列中是一致的。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家逐步將手向前推進，達到肩膀到手腕的近乎直線，而你的手保持靠近軀幹，肘部從未完全打開。這表明專家使用了完整的槓桿長度來獲得更大的擊球範圍和更平滑的力量，而你的短槓桿限制了接觸點和後續動作。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your forearm and grip tighten too early
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: Your forearm and grip stay highly active from the start of preparation instead of remaining relaxed until the forward swing. This early tension restricts free racket acceleration. Keep the hand loose during preparation, then tighten the grip briefly as you strike.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In the lower-arm EMG dashboard, Channel 2 (blue) sits around 0.5–0.6 unit-unspecified across frames 0-100 (shaded preparation/backswing) with almost no valleys, while the expert’s dashed trace drops well below 0.2 in the same interval and only rises sharply near the red-shaded forward-swing frames ≈110-130.
additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert shows a clear on-off pattern: low activity in early phases, then a brief peak just before and through contact. Your trace stays elevated the whole time, indicating continuous muscle engagement where the expert is relaxed. That difference suggests you are gripping early instead of timing the squeeze.

zh_Hant.name: 你的前臂和握拍過早繃緊
zh_Hant.details: 從準備動作開始，你的前臂和握拍已持續高度用力，沒有保持放鬆至前揮階段。過早繃緊會限制球拍自然加速。準備時保持手部放鬆，在擊球一刻才短暫收緊握拍。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在下臂肌電圖儀表板中，通道2（藍色）在幀0-100（陰影準備/後擺動作）中保持在約0.5–0.6未指定單位，幾乎沒有下降，而專家的虛線軌跡在相同區間內顯著下降至0.2以下，並僅在紅色陰影的前擺動作幀≈110-130附近急劇上升。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家顯示出明顯的開關模式：在早期階段活動量低，然後在接觸前後短暫達到高峰。而你的數據始終保持在高水平，表明肌肉持續緊張，而專家則是放鬆的。這種差異表明你過早握緊拍子，而不是在正確的時機施力。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your eyes move too widely after contact
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: Immediately after the hit, your gaze sweeps to the right and upward and then drops low instead of settling smoothly. Keep the head quiet through contact, then move the eyes deliberately toward the opponent and the next play.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In frames roughly 50-65 and again 75-85 (red-shaded zones), your gaze X rises from about −0.1 to +0.3 and Y climbs from −0.2 toward 0 before plunging to −0.3. The trajectory plot shows your blue path looping far outside the tight green cluster of the expert’s gaze, indicating larger, repeated excursions in the follow-through.
additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s gaze (green dashed line) stays within a narrow band around −0.2 on both axes after contact, showing a quick return to a stable central zone. Your gaze (solid blue) travels roughly three times farther in both directions, producing broad loops that are absent in the reference stroke.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球後，你的視線移動幅度過大
zh_Hant.details: 完成擊球後，你的視線先向右上方大幅移動，再迅速向下，而沒有平順地穩定下來。觸球前後先保持頭部安定，之後有目的地把視線移向對手和下一拍。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在大約第50-65幀和第75-85幀（紅色陰影區域），你的視線X從約−0.1上升到+0.3，Y從−0.2上升到接近0，然後下降到−0.3。軌跡圖顯示你的藍色路徑遠遠超出專家視線的緊密綠色群集，表明隨後動作中有更大的反覆偏移。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的視線（綠色虛線）在接觸後保持在兩個軸線約−0.2的窄範圍內，顯示快速回到穩定的中心區域。而你的視線（藍色實線）在兩個方向上移動約三倍距離，產生了參考擊球中不存在的寬大迴圈。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your non-racket arm stays too close to your body
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: At contact, your non-racket arm remains tucked near your torso instead of helping to counterbalance the racket arm. Let the free arm move slightly away from the body as you swing so your chest can rotate with better balance and control.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: At the contact frame, the racket-side arm is active while the opposite arm shows very little movement away from the torso.
additional_visual_hypotheses.rationale: An active non-racket arm acts as a counterbalance. It helps stabilize the trunk, supports controlled rotation, and makes it easier to recover after the shot.
additional_visual_hypotheses.actionable_cue: As the racket arm swings forward, let the non-racket arm reach slightly forward or outward to balance your chest rotation.
additional_visual_hypotheses.suggested_drill: Practise slow backhand shadow swings in front of a mirror. Check that the non-racket hand moves away from the torso and visibly balances the racket arm at contact.

zh_Hant.name: 你的非持拍手過度貼近身體
zh_Hant.details: 觸球時，你的非持拍手仍收在軀幹旁，未能協助平衡持拍手。揮拍時讓非持拍手稍微離開身體，使胸部能在更平衡、受控的狀態下旋轉。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在觸球畫面中，持拍側手臂正在主動揮動，但另一側手臂幾乎沒有離開軀幹。
zh_Hant.rationale: 主動運用非持拍手可以形成反向平衡，幫助穩定軀幹、控制旋轉，並讓擊球後回位更順暢。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 持拍手向前揮動時，讓非持拍手稍微向前或向外伸展，以平衡胸部旋轉。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前慢速練習反手空揮，確認觸球位置時非持拍手會離開軀幹，並與持拍手形成明顯的平衡。

coaching_actions.cue: Lift your elbow higher during the take-back so it lines up with your shoulder before the forward swing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A higher elbow creates a stronger, flatter hitting platform, helping you drive the shuttle rather than lifting it.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow the backhand drive in front of a mirror, focusing on raising the elbow to shoulder height before swinging forward.

zh_Hant.cue: 在回拍時抬高你的手肘，使其在向前揮拍前與肩膀對齊。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 較高的手肘能形成更強、更平的擊球平台，幫助你推動羽毛球而不是抬起它。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前模擬反手平抽球，專注於在向前揮拍前將手肘抬到肩膀高度。

coaching_actions.cue: Hinge at the hips so your chest is over your front knee as you take the racket back.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A forward-leaning posture pre-loads your legs and core, giving you better balance and energy transfer when you push into the swing.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practise shadow swings starting from a split-step, do a slight forward bend and feeling your weight on the front leg before initiating the stroke.

zh_Hant.cue: 髖部彎曲，使胸部位於前膝上方，然後回拍。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 向前傾的姿勢能預先激活腿部和核心肌群，幫助你在揮拍時更好地保持平衡並傳遞能量。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 從分腿步開始練習模擬揮拍，向前傾斜，感受重量集中在前腿上，然後開始擊球動作。

coaching_actions.cue: Before impact, allow your racket arm to extend smoothly toward the shuttlecock as you drive through.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Meeting the shuttle in front of your body with a smooth elbow extension helps you make earlier contact and lengthens your acceleration zone for a cleaner, sharper stroke.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slowly shadow-swing in front of a mirror, focusing on the smooth transition of your elbow from bent to extended, keeping the contact point in front of your body. Once the movement pattern feels natural, gradually increase your swing speed.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前，讓持拍手臂順暢地朝羽毛球的方向延伸發力。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在身體前方迎球並充分延伸手肘，能幫助你更早接觸球、拉長加速路徑，讓揮拍更乾淨利落。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前慢慢模擬揮拍，專注於手肘由彎曲到順暢延伸的揮拍軌跡，擊球點維持在身體前方，動作熟練後再逐漸加快速度。

coaching_actions.cue: Keep your grip loose during the set-up, squeeze only at the moment of impact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A relaxed forearm lets the racket accelerate smoothly and reduces unnecessary fatigue; tightening only at contact delivers power without slowing the swing.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow-swing with the racket held lightly, rehearse adding the squeeze only as the racket snaps through the imaginary shuttle.

zh_Hant.cue: 在準備階段保持握拍放鬆，只在擊球瞬間握緊拍子。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 放鬆的前臂能讓球拍平滑加速並減少不必要的疲勞；僅在接觸時握緊能提供力量而不減慢揮拍速度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 輕鬆握住球拍進行模擬揮拍，練習在球拍穿過假想羽毛球時才握緊。

coaching_actions.cue: After contact, let your gaze settle instead of scanning—keep it calmly centred for a split-second before tracking the next play.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A steadier gaze helps your head and upper body stay balanced, making it easier to recover and move for the next shot.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practise shadow swings while fixing your eyes on a small mark on the far court, holding focus for one count after each imaginary contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 接觸後讓視線穩定下來，不要四處掃視——保持視線平靜集中一瞬間，然後再追蹤下一個球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更穩定的視線能幫助你的頭部和上半身保持平衡，使你更容易恢復並移動到下一次擊球位置。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習模擬揮拍時，將視線固定在遠端球場上的一個小標記，並在每次假想接觸後保持專注一秒鐘。

coaching_actions.cue: Shift more body weight onto your left (non-racket) foot at the end of the backswing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A firm load on the lead leg stores energy and sets a stable base, enabling a stronger lateral push into the lunge and a quicker, more powerful stroke.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Perform slow-motion shadow swings focusing on feeling at least two-thirds of your weight pressing into the left insole just before initiating the forward swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在揮拍後擺結束時，將更多的身體重量轉移到你的左腳（非持拍腳）上。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在前腳施加穩固的力量可以儲存能量並建立穩定的基礎，從而使橫向推進更有力，並且能夠更快、更有力地完成擊球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 進行慢動作的空揮練習，專注於感受在引拍蓄勢完成的瞬間，至少有三分之二的重量壓在左腳鞋墊上。

coaching_output.summary:
The athlete is currently at the intermediate level, with some control and continuity but room for improvement in overall coordination. Their kinetic chain shows minor deviations in upper-arm, forearm, core, and thigh loading, with the wrist showing a significant lag in acceleration. The timing and rhythm reveal a notable lead in left-foot support, left thigh, and trunk/core, which may contribute to imbalances and inefficiencies in the backswing. This suggests a potential over-reliance on the left side, impacting overall power transfer and control.

The chain begins with the left foot, which has a significant lead in support, potentially causing misalignment in the rest of the body. The left thigh and trunk/core also lead, which may create an imbalance in the upper body. The left upper-arm leads, possibly due to a stronger load or improper sequencing. The right forearm is slightly behind, indicating a possible weakness in this area, while the distal wrist lags significantly, suggesting a lack of drive or proper force transfer. The most critical issue appears to be the wrist lag, which could hinder the ability to generate consistent power and control during the stroke.

To address these issues, the following training drills and goals are recommended:  
1. Foot alignment drill: Focus on correcting the left foot's alignment to ensure proper support and sequencing. Performance goal: Achieve neutral alignment with minimal deviation during baseline and backswing.  
2. Right-side strength and conditioning: Strengthen the right leg and core to balance the left side. Performance goal: Maintain a 1:1 ratio of left to right strength during baseline and backswing.  
3. Wrist drive and power transfer drill: Focus on generating a stronger, more consistent wrist drive. Performance goal: Increase wrist acceleration by 10% over 4 weeks while maintaining control.

zh_Hant.summary:
運動員目前處於中級水平，具備一定的控制力和連續性，但在整體協調性方面仍有改進空間。他們的動力鏈在上臂、前臂、核心和大腿負荷方面顯示出輕微偏差，而手腕的加速則存在顯著滯後。時間和節奏顯示左腳支撐、左大腿和軀幹/核心有明顯的領先，這可能導致揮拍時的不平衡和效率低下。這表明可能過度依賴左側，影響整體的力量傳遞和控制。

動力鏈始於左腳，其支撐明顯領先，可能導致身體其他部位的錯位。左大腿和軀幹/核心也領先，可能在上半身造成不平衡。左上臂領先，可能是由於更強的負荷或不正確的排序。右前臂稍微落後，表明該部位可能存在弱點，而遠端手腕顯著滯後，表明驅動力或力量傳遞不足。最關鍵的問題似乎是手腕滯後，這可能妨礙在揮拍過程中產生穩定的力量和控制。

為了解決這些問題，建議進行以下訓練和設定目標：
1. 腳步對齊訓練：專注於矯正左腳的對齊，以確保正確的支撐和排序。表現目標：在底線和揮拍過程中實現中性對齊，偏差最小。
2. 右側力量和體能訓練：加強右腿和核心力量，以平衡左側。表現目標：在底線和揮拍過程中保持左側與右側力量的1:1比例。
3. 手腕驅動和力量傳遞訓練：專注於產生更強、更穩定的手腕驅動。表現目標：在4週內手腕加速提高10%，同時保持控制力。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your backhand-drive action is compact and you complete a full swing, but the early preparation is limited in trunk turn and the follow-through leaves you off-balance. Improving how much you rotate and how you recover after contact will help you generate a faster, more stable shot and be ready for the next rally.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation in backswing
findings.details: By frame 27 your shoulders remain almost square to the front instead of turning so the hitting shoulder moves behind the non-hitting one.
findings.observed_evidence: In the backswing frame the line of the shoulders is nearly parallel to the hips; the spine shows only a small twist away from the shuttle side.
findings.why_it_matters: A deeper torso turn stores elastic energy and sets the racket farther back, helping you accelerate through the drive with less arm effort.
findings.actionable_cue: Start your preparation by turning your chest so that the hitting shoulder points more towards the rear court before you swing forward.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow the backhand drive slowly: exaggerate turning your upper body, pause, then swing forward, repeating 10× each side.

zh_Hant.name: 後擺動作中軀幹旋轉有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第27幀時，你的肩膀幾乎保持正面而未旋轉，使得擊球肩未移到非擊球肩後方。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在後擺動作幀中，肩膀的線幾乎與臀部平行；脊椎僅稍微向羽球一側扭轉。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的軀幹旋轉能儲存彈性能量並使球拍更向後擺，有助於你以更少的手臂力量加速完成平抽動作。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 開始準備時，將胸部旋轉，使擊球肩更指向後場，然後再向前揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢速模擬反手平抽動作：誇張地旋轉上半身，停頓，然後向前揮拍，每側重複10次。

findings.name: Passive non-racket arm
findings.details: At contact (frame 39) the non-racket arm is tucked near the torso instead of extending to counter-balance the hitting arm.
findings.observed_evidence: In the contact frame only the racket-side arm is active; the opposite arm shows minimal movement away from the body.
findings.why_it_matters: Using the non-racket arm as a counter-weight improves rotational speed and keeps the trunk centered, aiding power and control.
findings.actionable_cue: As you swing, let the free arm stretch slightly forward or upward to balance the chest rotation.
findings.suggested_drill: Mirror drill: stand side-on, practise backhand shadow swings while deliberately reaching the non-racket hand forward each time.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手動作被動
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球瞬間（第39幀），非持拍手靠近軀幹而未伸展以平衡持拍手的動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在擊球幀中，只有持拍側手臂是活躍的；相反側手臂幾乎沒有離開身體的動作。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 使用非持拍手作為平衡重心的配重能提高旋轉速度並保持軀幹居中，有助於力量和控制。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 揮拍時，讓自由手稍微向前或向上伸展，以平衡胸部旋轉。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子練習：側身站立，練習反手模擬揮拍動作，每次刻意將非持拍手向前伸展。

findings.name: Forward lean causing loss of balance
findings.details: From frames 54-81 the trunk pitches forward and the legs narrow, showing you over-commit your mass after contact.
findings.observed_evidence: The spine angle increases forward and the head moves well in front of the base of support; feet stay close instead of widening to stabilise.
findings.why_it_matters: Excess lean makes it harder to brake your momentum and recover for the next shot, especially against fast returns.
findings.actionable_cue: After contact keep your chest up and land with a wider, slightly bent front knee to absorb the swing.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your swing shows clear phase sequencing, but three areas limit racket speed and control: limited upper-body rotation before contact, late wrist/forearm firing, and weight remaining on the rear (right) foot through impact. findings.name: Minimal trunk rotation before forward swing
findings.details: In the backswing (frame 27) your hips and shoulders stay almost square to the net; the chest turns only a few degrees before you start the forward swing at frame 36-39.
findings.observed_evidence: Stick-skeleton shows upper-body lines for shoulders and hips remaining nearly parallel from frame 14 to 27, with no visible coil.
findings.why_it_matters: A small torso coil reduces elastic stretch in the trunk muscles and limits the stored energy you can release into the racket. More rotation would set up a quicker, more powerful drive.
findings.actionable_cue: Before driving, allow your non-racket shoulder to turn slightly past the shuttle line—think ‘show your back to the net’, then unwind sharply.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand drives: pause in backswing, exaggerate torso turn, then snap forward; film yourself to match the desired shoulder angle.

zh_Hant.name: 向前揮拍前軀幹旋轉不足
zh_Hant.details: 在後揮拍動作中（第27幀），你的臀部和肩膀幾乎保持與球網平行；胸部在第36至39幀開始向前揮拍前僅旋轉了幾度。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架模型顯示從第14幀到第27幀，肩膀和臀部的上半身線條幾乎保持平行，沒有明顯的扭轉。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 軀幹的輕微扭轉減少了軀幹肌肉的彈性拉伸，限制了你可以釋放到球拍中的儲存能量。更多的旋轉將有助於打出更快、更有力的平抽球。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在平抽球之前，讓你的非持拍肩稍微轉過羽毛球的延長線——想像一下“背對球網”，然後迅速展開動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習反手平抽球：在後揮拍時停頓，誇張地轉動軀幹，然後迅速向前揮拍；錄影以檢查肩膀角度是否達到目標。

findings.name: Delayed wrist/forearm activation
findings.details: Upper-arm EMG channels (1-4) peak around frames 45-55, after shuttle contact at frame 39, while channels 5 & 8 (often wrist/finger flexors/extensors) show their main spike even later (~frame 100).
findings.observed_evidence: EMG Upper 1-4 rise just after contact; EMG Upper 5 & 8 show largest burst long into follow-through.
findings.why_it_matters: Power and shuttle control in a backhand drive come from a timely wrist snap at, not after, contact. Late activation suggests you may be ‘pushing’ rather than ‘snapping’, costing shuttle speed.
findings.actionable_cue: Feel the wrist tighten and snap just before the racket meets the shuttle—imagine ‘cracking a whip’ at impact.
findings.suggested_drill: Use a light racket and hit continuous backhand drives focusing on an early, crisp wrist snap, then review timing on video.

zh_Hant.name: 手腕/前臂啟動延遲
zh_Hant.details: 上臂肌電圖（EMG）通道1-4在第45至55幀（擊球點為第39幀）達到峰值，而通道5和8（通常為手腕/手指屈肌/伸肌）則在更晚的時間（約第100幀）出現主要峰值。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 上臂EMG通道1-4在擊球後剛開始上升；EMG通道5和8在隨後的揮拍過程中顯示出最大的爆發。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 反手平抽球的力量和控球來自於擊球時而非擊球後的及時手腕甩動。啟動延遲表明你可能是在“推”而不是“甩”，這會降低球速。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 感覺手腕在球拍接觸羽毛球前緊繃並甩動——想像在擊球時“甩鞭子”的動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 使用輕量球拍，連續練習反手平抽球，專注於早而乾脆的手腕甩動，然後通過錄影檢查時機。

findings.name: Weight remains on rear foot at contact
findings.details: At contact (frame 39) your right (rear) foot shows higher insole pressures while the left (front) foot is just starting to load, indicating limited forward transfer.
findings.observed_evidence: Right insole traces (channels 1-4) peak near frame 35-45, whereas left insole peaks lag by ~5-10 frames; skeleton shows centre of mass staying nearer rear leg at frame 39.
findings.why_it_matters: Driving through the shuttle requires shifting weight onto the racket-side foot in a timely manner to stabilise the stroke and recover quickly. Staying back can reduce shot stability and delay recovery.
findings.actionable_cue: Plant your racket-side foot a fraction earlier and push body weight onto it before the wrist snap.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow step-in drives: start in neutral, step onto racket-side foot, pause to feel weight over that foot, then perform the drive.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時重心停留在後腳

zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 右腳鞋墊壓力（通道1-4）在第35至45幀達到峰值，而左腳鞋墊壓力峰值滯後約5-10幀；骨架模型顯示在第39幀時重心仍靠近後腿。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 通過羽毛球時需要及時將重心轉移到持拍側的腳上，以穩定揮拍並快速恢復。重心停留在後方可能會降低擊球穩定性並延遲恢復。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 稍早將持拍側的腳落地，並在手腕甩動前將身體重心轉移到該腳上。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習跨步平抽球：從中立位置開始，跨步到持拍側腳，停頓感受重心轉移到該腳上，然後完成平抽球動作。

findings.name: Head and gaze lift immediately after contact
findings.details: Gaze trace shows a sharp upward shift around frames 60-70, and skeleton frames 54-68 show your head rising early while the racket is still travelling forward.
findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze ‘y’ jumps from ~-0.25 to near 0.0 between frames 60-70; skeleton at frame 54 already shows head lifting although arm still extending.
findings.why_it_matters: Looking up too soon can open the hitting shoulder and compromise racket stability, causing flatter drives to miss their intended trajectory.
findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes on the point of contact a split-second longer—‘watch the strings brush the shuttle’ before tracking the flight.
findings.suggested_drill: Feed drill: partner feeds easy backhand drives; focus on saying ‘hit’ only after you see the shuttle leave the strings, training delayed head lift.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球後頭部和視線立即抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線軌跡顯示在第60至70幀之間有明顯的向上移動，而骨架數據在第54至68幀顯示你的頭部在球拍仍向前揮動時就已經提前抬起。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛的“y”軸視線在第60至70幀之間從約-0.25跳至接近0.0；骨架數據在第54幀已顯示頭部抬起，儘管手臂仍在延伸。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早抬頭可能會導致擊球肩部打開，影響球拍的穩定性，從而使平抽球偏離預定軌跡。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 將目光多停留在擊球點一瞬間——“看著球拍線刷過羽毛球”後再追蹤球的飛行路徑。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 餵球訓練：搭檔餵簡單的反手平抽球；專注於在看到羽毛球離開球拍線後才說“打”，以訓練延遲抬頭。

zh_Hant.summary: 你的揮拍顯示出明顯的動作分段，但有三個方面限制了球拍的速度和控制：擊球前上半身旋轉不足、手腕/前臂啟動過晚，以及擊球時重心仍然停留在後（右）腳上。改善這些問題將有助於你打出更平、更快的反手平抽球，並更快地恢復場上平衡。

zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習反手平抽球：在後揮拍時停頓，誇張地轉動軀幹，然後迅速向前揮拍；錄影以檢查肩膀角度是否達到目標。

confirmed_findings.name: Delayed wrist/forearm activation
confirmed_findings.details: Upper-arm EMG channels (1-4) peak around frames 45-55, after shuttle contact at frame 39, while channels 5 & 8 (often wrist/finger flexors/extensors) show their main spike even later (~frame 100).
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: EMG Upper 1-4 rise just after contact; EMG Upper 5 & 8 show largest burst long into follow-through.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Power and shuttle control in a backhand drive come from a timely wrist snap at, not after, contact. Late activation suggests you may be ‘pushing’ rather than ‘snapping’, costing shuttle speed.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Feel the wrist tighten and snap just before the racket meets the shuttle—imagine ‘cracking a whip’ at impact.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Use a light racket and hit continuous backhand drives focusing on an early, crisp wrist snap, then review timing on video.

zh_Hant.name: 手腕/前臂啟動延遲
zh_Hant.details: 上臂肌電圖（EMG）通道1-4在第45至55幀（擊球點為第39幀）達到峰值，而通道5和8（通常為手腕/手指屈肌/伸肌）則在更晚的時間（約第100幀）出現主要峰值。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 上臂EMG通道1-4在擊球後剛開始上升；EMG通道5和8在隨後的揮拍過程中顯示出最大的爆發。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 反手平抽球的力量和控球來自於擊球時而非擊球後的及時手腕甩動。啟動延遲表明你可能是在“推”而不是“甩”，這會降低球速。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 感覺手腕在球拍接觸羽毛球前緊繃並甩動——想像在擊球時“甩鞭子”的動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 使用輕量球拍，連續練習反手平抽球，專注於早而乾脆的手腕甩動，然後通過錄影檢查時機。

confirmed_findings.name: Weight remains on rear foot at contact
confirmed_findings.details: At contact (frame 39) your right (rear) foot shows higher insole pressures while the left (front) foot is just starting to load, indicating limited forward transfer.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Right insole traces (channels 1-4) peak near frame 35-45, whereas left insole peaks lag by ~5-10 frames; skeleton shows centre of mass staying nearer rear leg at frame 39.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Driving through the shuttle requires shifting weight onto the racket-side foot in a timely manner to stabilise the stroke and recover quickly. Staying back can reduce shot stability and delay recovery.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Plant your racket-side foot a fraction earlier and push body weight onto it before the wrist snap.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow step-in drives: start in neutral, step onto racket-side foot, pause to feel weight over that foot, then perform the drive.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時重心停留在後腳
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球時（第39幀），你的右（後）腳顯示鞋墊壓力較高，而左（前）腳才剛開始承重，表明向前的重心轉移有限。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 右腳鞋墊壓力（通道1-4）在第35至45幀達到峰值，而左腳鞋墊壓力峰值滯後約5-10幀；骨架模型顯示在第39幀時重心仍靠近後腿。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 通過羽毛球時需要及時將重心轉移到持拍側的腳上，以穩定揮拍並快速恢復。重心停留在後方可能會降低擊球穩定性並延遲恢復。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 稍早將持拍側的腳落地，並在手腕甩動前將身體重心轉移到該腳上。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習跨步平抽球：從中立位置開始，跨步到持拍側腳，停頓感受重心轉移到該腳上，然後完成平抽球動作。

confirmed_findings.name: Head and gaze lift immediately after contact
confirmed_findings.details: Gaze trace shows a sharp upward shift around frames 60-70, and skeleton frames 54-68 show your head rising early while the racket is still travelling forward.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze ‘y’ jumps from ~-0.25 to near 0.0 between frames 60-70; skeleton at frame 54 already shows head lifting although arm still extending.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Looking up too soon can open the hitting shoulder and compromise racket stability, causing flatter drives to miss their intended trajectory.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes on the point of contact a split-second longer—‘watch the strings brush the shuttle’ before tracking the flight.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Feed drill: partner feeds easy backhand drives; focus on saying ‘hit’ only after you see the shuttle leave the strings, training delayed head lift.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球後頭部和視線立即抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線軌跡顯示在第60至70幀之間有明顯的向上移動，而骨架數據在第54至68幀顯示你的頭部在球拍仍向前揮動時就已經提前抬起。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛的“y”軸視線在第60至70幀之間從約-0.25跳至接近0.0；骨架數據在第54幀已顯示頭部抬起，儘管手臂仍在延伸。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早抬頭可能會導致擊球肩部打開，影響球拍的穩定性，從而使平抽球偏離預定軌跡。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 將目光多停留在擊球點一瞬間——“看著球拍線刷過羽毛球”後再追蹤球的飛行路徑。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 餵球訓練：搭檔餵簡單的反手平抽球；專注於在看到羽毛球離開球拍線後才說“打”，以訓練延遲抬頭。

coaching_actions.cue: Turn the upper body more in the backswing, then snap the wrist right at contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A deeper coil plus timely wrist release will add racket-head speed and a flatter, faster drive without extra arm effort.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Mirror shadow swings: mark shoulder turn angles on floor, rehearse turn-coil-snap sequence slowly, then at full speed, filming for feedback.

zh_Hant.cue: 在後擺時多轉動上半身，然後在擊球瞬間快速甩動手腕。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的身體扭轉加上適時的手腕釋放，能增加球拍頭的速度，實現更平、更快的平抽球，而不需要額外的手臂用力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子影子揮拍練習：在地板上標記肩部轉動角度，慢速練習轉身-扭轉-甩動的動作順序，然後以全速進行，並錄影以便反饋。

coaching_actions.cue: Shift weight onto the racket-side foot before striking.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: An early weight transfer stabilises your base and frees the arm for a cleaner, straighter drive, improving accuracy and recovery.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Front-foot landing drill: start in split-step, push off, land on racket-side foot, freeze, check balance, then hit a shuttle fed by a partner.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前將重心轉移到持拍側的腳上。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 提前轉移重心能穩定你的基礎，讓手臂更自由地完成更乾淨、更直的平抽球，從而提高準確性和回位速度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在羽毛球接觸球拍後再抬頭。

coaching_actions.cue: Delay head lift until after shuttle contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Maintaining visual focus on contact improves timing and reduces mishits.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Use slow-feed drives; consciously keep gaze on shuttle until you hear it leave the strings, gradually increase speed while keeping the habit.

zh_Hant.cue: 延遲抬頭直到羽毛球接觸球拍後。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 保持視線專注於擊球點能改善擊球時機並減少失誤。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 使用慢速餵球練習；有意識地將視線保持在羽毛球上，直到聽到球離開球拍線的聲音，然後逐漸加快速度，同時保持這個習慣。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary:
Racket Leg Not Stepping Toward Hitting Point; Insufficient Forearm Supinator Pre-Load; Insufficient Non-Racket (Left) Leg Loading; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Premature Court Anticipation Shift; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Pre-Contact Gaze Escape; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze; Delayed or Weak Recovery Push-Off; Passive Recovery (No Active Drive).

During your backswing you stay almost upright through every sampled frame instead of hinging forward from the hips. Let your chest angle come forward so your shoulders sit slightly in front of your hips while you load. This forward lean helps you shift bodyweight toward the striking side and sets up a stronger drive into the shuttle. During your forward swing your racket-arm elbow stays noticeably bent, so your racket hand never travels fully past your front knee before the hit. Aim to let the elbow open more and let the hand finish further in front of the body. That extra reach gives you cleaner contact and a longer acceleration path. At the instant you strike (around the forward-swing contact frame), your centre of pressure sits back toward your heels on both feet instead of progressing onto the balls of the feet. Staying on your heels makes it harder to drive power forward through the shuttle and slows your transition into the next step. Think about rolling your weight from heel to forefoot so that, by contact, you are ‘on your toes’ and ready to push off immediately after the hit.

Initiate the stroke by stepping your right foot forward and slightly across toward the shuttle before starting the swing. Let your chest tilt forward over the front foot as you draw the racket back. Let your racket arm straighten fully so your hand finishes well in front of your body at contact. Activate and ‘wind up’ your forearm muscles progressively during the backswing to store elastic energy. Keep your eyes steady on the shuttle until after impact before shifting gaze toward the target. Finish the hit up on the balls of your feet, not sitting back on the heels.

在你的後擺動作中，整個取樣幀中你幾乎保持直立，而不是從髖部向前傾。讓你的胸部角度向前傾，使肩膀稍微位於髖部前方，同時進行負重。這種向前傾斜有助於將身體重量轉移到擊球側，並為更有力的擊球做好準備。在你的前擺動作中，球拍手臂的肘部明顯彎曲，因此你的球拍手在擊球前從未完全超過前膝。目標是讓肘部更大程度地伸展，並讓手在擊球時完成於身體前方更遠的位置。這額外的伸展可以讓你獲得更乾淨的接觸和更長的加速路徑。在你擊球的瞬間（大約在前擺動接觸幀），你的壓力中心位於雙腳的腳跟附近，而不是向前移到腳掌。保持在腳跟上會使你更難向前通過球進行有力的推進，並減慢你進入下一步的過渡。考慮將重量從腳跟滾動到前腳掌，這樣在接觸時你就能“踮起腳尖”，並在擊球後立即準備推蹬。

通過在揮拍前先向前邁右腳並稍微向球方向跨步來啟動擊球動作。當你將球拍向後拉時，讓胸部向前傾斜至前腳上方。讓你的球拍手臂完全伸直，確保手在接觸時完成於身體前方。逐步激活並“預拉伸”你的前臂肌肉，在後擺動作中儲存彈性能量。在擊球前保持眼睛穩定注視球，然後再將視線轉向目標。完成擊球時，腳掌應落在前腳掌上，而不是坐回腳跟。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary:
Racket Leg Not Stepping Toward Hitting Point; Insufficient Forearm Supinator Pre-Load; Insufficient Non-Racket (Left) Leg Loading; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Premature Court Anticipation Shift; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Pre-Contact Gaze Escape; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze; Delayed or Weak Recovery Push-Off; Passive Recovery (No Active Drive).

During your backswing you stay almost upright through every sampled frame instead of hinging forward from the hips. Let your chest angle come forward so your shoulders sit slightly in front of your hips while you load. This forward lean helps you shift bodyweight toward the striking side and sets up a stronger drive into the shuttle. During your forward swing your racket-arm elbow stays noticeably bent, so your racket hand never travels fully past your front knee before the hit. Aim to let the elbow open more and let the hand finish further in front of the body. That extra reach gives you cleaner contact and a longer acceleration path. At the instant you strike (around the forward-swing contact frame), your centre of pressure sits back toward your heels on both feet instead of progressing onto the balls of the feet. Staying on your heels makes it harder to drive power forward through the shuttle and slows your transition into the next step. Think about rolling your weight from heel to forefoot so that, by contact, you are ‘on your toes’ and ready to push off immediately after the hit.

Initiate the stroke by stepping your right foot forward and slightly across toward the shuttle before starting the swing. Let your chest tilt forward over the front foot as you draw the racket back. Let your racket arm straighten fully so your hand finishes well in front of your body at contact. Activate and ‘wind up’ your forearm muscles progressively during the backswing to store elastic energy. Keep your eyes steady on the shuttle until after impact before shifting gaze toward the target. Finish the hit up on the balls of your feet, not sitting back on the heels.

raw_evidence_results.name: Insufficient Forearm Supinator Pre-Load
raw_evidence_results.details: lower_late_backswing_rise=-0.0950933; lower=-0.0433772.
raw_evidence_results.evaluation: Problem: Insufficient Forearm Supinator Pre-Load. Abnormally low lower arm EMG during the backswing, indicating failure to eccentrically load the forearm supinators and wrist extensors. zh_Hant.evidence: 在壓力圖（第F37至F43幀）中，你的鞋墊顯示最熱的顏色（紅色/橙色）集中在後腳區域，第二個面板上的壓力中心標記明顯更靠近腳跟邊緣。而專家在相同幀中顯示前腳掌下方的壓力為綠色/黃色，壓力中心標記位於更靠近每隻腳的前腳掌位置。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的壓力中心在前揮擊過程中向前移動，最終停留在跖骨頭部附近，表明前腳掌承受了主動的負荷，支持快速推進完成揮拍。而你的壓力中心保持在後方，顯示你依賴於腳跟。這種差異表明你未能完成專家用來穩定上半身旋轉並準備立即恢復的前重心轉移。

coaching_actions.cue: Initiate the stroke by stepping your right foot forward and slightly across toward the shuttle before starting the swing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A proactive step lets you transfer body weight into the shot, adding stability and power instead of striking from a static stance.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow-step drives: From a ready stance, repeatedly step the racket foot forward-across and mimic the backswing to groove early footwork timing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在開始揮拍之前，先將右腳向前並稍微跨向羽毛球的方向邁出一步。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 主動的跨步可以將身體重量轉移到擊球上，增加穩定性和力量，而不是從靜止的站姿進行擊球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子步驟推擊：從準備姿勢開始，反覆將持拍腳向前跨步，模仿後揮動作，以培養早期步法的節奏感。

coaching_actions.cue: During the backswing, perform a moderate hip hinge to lean forward, keeping your chest stably aligned vertically with your front knee.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Hinging at the hips pre-loads the primary muscles in your glutes and legs, allowing for an explosive drive while maintaining balance and protecting the knee joint.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practice shadow swings starting from a split-step. Focus on leaning forward initiated by the hip hinge, feeling the engagement in your glutes and thighs while ensuring your front knee does not extend past your toes.

zh_Hant.cue: 引拍時適度屈髖俯身，保持胸部與膝蓋在穩定的垂直線上。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 屈髖能預先載入臀部與腿部肌群的大肌肉，在保持平衡與保護膝蓋的前提下爆發性推進。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 從分腿步開始練習影子揮拍，專注於由髖部彎曲帶動俯身，感受臀部與大腿受力，膝蓋不超過腳尖。

coaching_actions.cue: Extend your racket arm smoothly toward the shuttlecock to meet it in front of your body during the forward swing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Contacting the shuttle in the sweet spot in front of your body lengthens the effective acceleration distance and maximizes swing range while safeguarding your elbow joint.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practice shadow swings in front of a mirror, focusing on the smooth transition of your elbow from bent to extended. Keep the contact point at a comfortable distance—roughly a fist to a forearm’s length—ahead and slightly above your front knee.

zh_Hant.cue: 揮拍時順暢地向前方迎球，讓手臂在身體前方適度延伸。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在身體前方的甜區接觸羽毛球，能拉長有效加速路徑並獲得最大揮拍空間，同時保護手肘關節。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習影子揮拍，專注於手肘由彎曲到順暢伸展的軌跡，擊球點維持在前膝前上方約一個拳頭至小臂的舒適距離。

coaching_actions.cue: Activate and ‘wind up’ your forearm muscles progressively during the backswing to store elastic energy.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Building a gradual supinator preload helps release a faster, crisper snap at impact, boosting racket-head speed.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practice slow-to-fast shadow swings focusing on feeling a gentle forearm twist (supination) build during the take-back, then release quickly at the imagined contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 在後揮過程中逐漸激活並“預拉伸”你的前臂肌肉，以儲存彈性能量。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 逐漸建立旋後肌的預拉伸有助於在擊球時釋放更快、更乾脆的揮拍，提升球拍頭的速度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習從慢到快的影子揮拍，專注於感受在後拉過程中前臂輕微的旋後動作，然後在想像的接觸點快速釋放。

coaching_actions.cue: Keep your eyes steady on the shuttle until after impact before shifting gaze toward the target.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Early eye drift and vertical drop during the forward swing reduce the precision of your racket–shuttle alignment, harming shot accuracy.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow-swing while fixating a small mark at eye level, releasing gaze only after the swing completes, to ingrain late gaze shift habits.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球後再將目光從羽毛球轉向目標之前，始終穩定地注視著羽毛球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在前揮過程中過早移動視線或視線下垂會降低球拍與羽毛球對準的精確性，影響擊球的準確性。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在影子揮拍時，專注於注視與眼睛齊平的小標記，直到揮拍完成後才移開視線，以養成延遲移動視線的習慣。

coaching_actions.cue: Finish the hit up on the balls of your feet, not sitting back on the heels.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Getting your weight forward at contact stabilises the stroke and sets up a faster first recovery step.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practise shadow backhands focusing on rolling from heel to toe and finishing each swing in a light, ‘ready to push’ forefoot stance.

zh_Hant.cue: 完成擊球時要站在腳掌上，而不是坐在腳跟上。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在擊球時將重心向前有助於穩定擊球，並為更快的第一步恢復做好準備。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習影子反手時，專注於從腳跟滾動到腳趾，並在每次揮拍後以輕鬆的「準備推進」前腳掌姿勢結束。

coaching_output.summary: Your backhand-drive action is controlled, but several simple posture adjustments can unlock more reach, stability, and racket speed.

findings.name: Minimal torso rotation
findings.details: In frames 14 and 27 your shoulders stay almost square to the front and the ribcage shows little turning away from the shuttle.
findings.observed_evidence: Compared with frame 0, the line between the two shoulder joints changes only slightly in frames 14 → 27.
findings.why_it_matters: A larger upper-body coil stores elastic energy and positions the arm behind the shuttle, helping you hit flatter, faster drives.
findings.actionable_cue: During the take-back, allow your chest and hips to turn so your back faces the net slightly before you start the forward swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow 10 slow backhand drives focusing on turning your shoulders 30–45° away, then uncoiling while keeping balance.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹旋轉幅度小
zh_Hant.details: 在第14和27幀中，你的肩膀幾乎保持正對前方，胸腔幾乎沒有向羽毛球方向轉動。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 與第0幀相比，第14至27幀中兩肩關節之間的線僅略有變化。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更大的上半身旋轉可以儲存彈性能量，並將手臂置於羽毛球後方，有助於擊出更平、更快的平抽球。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在回拍過程中，讓胸部和臀部轉動，使背部稍微面向球網，然後再開始向前揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習10次慢速反手平抽，專注於肩膀向後旋轉30–45°，然後在保持平衡的情況下展開旋轉。

findings.name: Narrow, parallel stance
findings.details: Throughout the sequence (e.g., frames 0, 27, 37) both feet stay almost in line with limited step into the shot.
findings.observed_evidence: The distance between the two ankle joints remains small and the front foot does not advance during the forward swing.
findings.why_it_matters: A wider, staggered stance lets you transfer body weight into the shuttle and improves court coverage after the stroke.
findings.actionable_cue: Plant your racket-leg foot slightly ahead and outside your body line as you load, then drive off it through contact.
findings.suggested_drill: Practise ‘step-in drives’: feed yourself shuttles, emphasising a clear lunge or step with the racket foot before each backhand drive.

zh_Hant.name: 窄且平行的站姿
zh_Hant.details: 在整個動作過程中（例如第0、27、37幀），雙腳幾乎保持在一條直線上，進攻時步伐有限。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 兩腳踝之間的距離保持較小，前腳在向前揮拍時並未向前移動。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更寬、更交錯的站姿可以幫助你將身體重量轉移到羽毛球上，並改善擊球後的場地覆蓋能力。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在蓄力時，將持拍腿的腳稍微向前並超出身體線，然後在擊球時用該腳發力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習“跨步平抽”：自己餵球，強調在每次反手平抽前用持拍腳清晰地跨步或向前一步。

findings.name: Inactive non-racket arm
findings.details: At contact (frame 37) the non-racket arm hangs low rather than extending forward for counter-balance.
findings.observed_evidence: The non-racket elbow is close to the torso and well below shoulder height in frames 37–54.
findings.why_it_matters: Using the non-racket arm for counter-balance helps stabilise the trunk and maintain court awareness, aiding accuracy and quick recovery.
findings.actionable_cue: As you swing, point your free arm toward the shuttle, then retract it for balance after contact.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand swings in front of a mirror, exaggerating the reach of your non-racket arm to build the habit.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手不活躍
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球瞬間（第37幀），非持拍手低垂，而不是向前伸展以保持平衡。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第37至54幀中，非持拍手肘靠近軀幹，並且遠低於肩膀高度。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 使用非持拍手來保持平衡有助於穩定軀幹並保持場地意識，從而提高準確性和快速恢復能力。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 揮拍時，用非持拍手指向羽毛球，然後在擊球後收回以保持平衡。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習反手揮拍，誇張非持拍手的伸展動作以養成習慣。

zh_Hant.summary: 你的反手平抽動作控制得很好，但幾個簡單的姿勢調整可以提升擊球範圍、穩定性和球拍速度。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your backhand-drive shows good intent, yet three areas stand out: the contact happens with the arm still folded close to the body, your weight remains on the rear foot until after impact, and the main muscle burst in the hitting arm occurs too early. Tidying these points will help you strike the shuttle sooner, transfer power more efficiently, and stay balanced for the next shot.

findings.name: Contact made with bent elbow close to torso
findings.details: At the contact image (frame 37) your hitting arm is still noticeably flexed and the hand sits only a short distance in front of your chest; the shoulder line stays almost square rather than rotated through.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton frame 37 shows elbow well above 90° flexion and racket-hand close to the mid-line; torso rotation appears limited.
findings.why_it_matters: Striking with the arm folded reduces reach and shortens the lever, making it harder to generate a flat, fast drive and forces a late contact point that can lift the shuttle or lose control.
findings.actionable_cue: On the final step, let the elbow unfold so the racket head and hand finish farther in front of your leading hip at impact.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand drives in front of a mirror: start from ready position, step and swing while checking that the hitting arm straightens and contact would occur just in front of the body line.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘彎曲且靠近軀幹
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球影像（第37幀）中，你的擊球手臂仍然明顯彎曲，手僅距胸部不遠；肩膀線條幾乎保持方正，而不是旋轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架影像第37幀顯示手肘彎曲超過90度，球拍手靠近身體中線；軀幹旋轉似乎有限。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手臂彎曲擊球會減少擊球範圍並縮短槓桿，導致難以打出平直快速的抽球，並迫使擊球點延遲，可能導致球上升或失去控制。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在最後一步時，讓手肘展開，使球拍頭和手在擊球時更靠近前側髖部。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習反手平抽球：從準備姿勢開始，邁步並揮拍，同時檢查擊球手臂是否伸直，擊球點是否位於身體線前方。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary:
Premature Leg Drive Activation; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Quiet Eye Onset Failure; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Quiet Eye Disruption at Contact; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your forward swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten as the hand travels toward the shuttle. Try to let the elbow open a little more in the last part of the swing so your forearm and upper arm form almost a straight line at contact. This longer lever helps you reach the shuttle earlier and lets the whole arm accelerate the racket smoothly. Through the whole motion—especially as you drive the racket forward—your rear-shoulder stabilisers stay almost silent. That leaves your shoulder complex less supported when the forces climb in the forward swing, which can let the racket path wander and cost both power and precision. Before you launch the arm, consciously set the shoulder by activating the back-of-shoulder muscles and keep a modest engagement as you accelerate through the shuttle.

Plant your racket-side foot firmly before you hit, stepping into the shot. Let the racket arm straighten fully just before you strike, reaching forward rather than keeping the elbow bent. Set your back-of-shoulder muscles (gently pull the shoulder blade down and back) before you start the forward swing and keep a light activation as you hit through. Anchor your gaze on the shuttle for a brief moment just before contact, then let it go immediately after the hit.

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary:
Premature Leg Drive Activation; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Quiet Eye Onset Failure; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Quiet Eye Disruption at Contact; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your forward swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten as the hand travels toward the shuttle. Try to let the elbow open a little more in the last part of the swing so your forearm and upper arm form almost a straight line at contact. This longer lever helps you reach the shuttle earlier and lets the whole arm accelerate the racket smoothly. Through the whole motion—especially as you drive the racket forward—your rear-shoulder stabilisers stay almost silent. That leaves your shoulder complex less supported when the forces climb in the forward swing, which can let the racket path wander and cost both power and precision. Before you launch the arm, consciously set the shoulder by activating the back-of-shoulder muscles and keep a modest engagement as you accelerate through the shuttle.

Plant your racket-side foot firmly before you hit, stepping into the shot. Let the racket arm straighten fully just before you strike, reaching forward rather than keeping the elbow bent. Set your back-of-shoulder muscles (gently pull the shoulder blade down and back) before you start the forward swing and keep a light activation as you hit through. Anchor your gaze on the shuttle for a brief moment just before contact, then let it go immediately after the hit.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your backhand drive is consistent, but several key timing and posture details are limiting power and control. The video shows a small trunk turn, a fully straight hitting arm at contact, a weight-shift that happens after the shuttle is struck, and a momentary head lift. Addressing these areas should help you load your body better, transfer energy sooner, and keep the shuttle flatter and more accurate.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation in preparation
findings.details: From frames 0-27 your shoulders and hips stay almost square to the net while the racket arm moves back. The torso shows only a small coil.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton images at frames 0, 14 and 27 display modest change in shoulder/hip orientation; hips remain nearly parallel to the front.
findings.why_it_matters: A deeper shoulder-hip turn stores elastic energy and positions the racket for a shorter, faster forward swing—key for a powerful, quick backhand drive.
findings.actionable_cue: During preparation, rotate your non-racket shoulder slightly forward and point your chest more towards the rear court before starting the forward swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Mirror shadow swings: face a mirror, exaggerate turning the torso so your back faces the net, then snap back to contact position while keeping feet stable.

zh_Hant.name: 準備動作中軀幹旋轉幅度有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第0到27幀之間，你的肩膀和臀部幾乎保持與球網平行，而球拍手臂向後移動。軀幹僅顯示出輕微的扭轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第0、14和27幀的骨架圖像中，肩膀和臀部的方向變化不大；臀部幾乎保持與前方平行。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的肩膀和臀部轉動可以儲存彈性能量，並將球拍置於更短、更快的前揮位置——這是實現強力快速反手平抽球的關鍵。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在準備動作中，稍微向前旋轉非持拍手的肩膀，並將胸部更多地指向後場，然後再開始前揮動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子影子揮拍練習：面對鏡子，誇張地轉動軀幹，讓背部面向球網，然後迅速回到擊球位置，同時保持雙腳穩定。

findings.name: Elbow fully locked at contact
findings.details: At frame 41 your racket arm is almost completely straight with the elbow locked out as you meet the shuttle.
findings.observed_evidence: The contact-frame stick figure shows a straight line from shoulder through wrist, indicating minimal elbow flexion.
findings.why_it_matters: Locking the elbow reduces the wrist’s whipping action and makes timing harder, which can lead to reduced shuttle speed and limited directional control.
findings.actionable_cue: Aim to keep a slight bend in the elbow (about 15°) at contact, allowing the forearm and wrist to snap through.
findings.suggested_drill: Half-court wall drives: stand close to a wall and hit continuous backhand drives, focusing on a soft elbow and a late wrist snap.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘完全鎖死
zh_Hant.details: 在第41幀時，你的球拍手臂幾乎完全伸直，手肘在擊球時鎖死。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 擊球幀的骨架圖顯示從肩膀到手腕是一條直線，表明手肘幾乎沒有彎曲。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手肘鎖死會減少手腕的鞭打動作，並使時機更難掌握，這可能導致球速降低和方向控制受限。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時保持手肘略微彎曲（約15°），允許前臂和手腕完成鞭打動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 半場牆壁平抽練習：站在靠近牆壁的地方，連續進行反手平抽球，專注於保持手肘柔軟並在最後一刻進行手腕鞭打。

findings.name: Weight shift happens after contact
findings.details: Pressure on the front (receiving) foot rises notably only after frame ~50, several frames after the contact at frame 41.
findings.observed_evidence: Both left and right insole traces show low values through contact, then a clear surge beginning roughly 10 frames later.
findings.why_it_matters: Late weight transfer means the stroke relies on the arm rather than whole-body momentum, limiting drive speed and making recovery slower.
findings.actionable_cue: Start pushing off your rear foot just before the swing, so your weight is already moving forward at contact.
findings.suggested_drill: Step-in drive drill: from a neutral stance, step with the rear foot and drive the shuttle, aiming to land on the front foot exactly as the racket meets the shuttle.

zh_Hant.name: 重心轉移發生在擊球之後

findings.name: Lower-body muscle activation lags upper-body
findings.details: Upper-arm channels peak around frames 10-15 and again near 40, whereas major leg channels (Leg EMG 1 & 4) spike later, peaking around frames 55-65.
findings.observed_evidence: EMG plots show distinct early peaks in upper EMG 1/2 before contact; leg EMG peaks are delayed until after contact.
findings.why_it_matters: For an efficient kinetic chain, force should start from the legs and hips, then flow to the arm. A reverse order can strain the shoulder and decrease racket speed.
findings.actionable_cue: Focus on initiating the stroke by driving through your legs and hips first, letting that momentum carry into the arm swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Medicine-ball side throws on the backhand side: emphasise pushing from the legs and rotating the torso before the arms release the ball.

zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 為了達到高效的動力鏈，力量應從腿部和臀部開始，然後流向手臂。反向順序可能會使肩膀承受壓力並降低球拍速度。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 專注於通過腿部和臀部的推動來啟動擊球，讓這股動能傳遞到手臂揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 藥球反手側拋：強調從腿部推動並旋轉軀幹，然後手臂釋放球。

findings.name: Head lifts during contact
findings.details: Gaze traces show a sharp vertical and horizontal shift exactly at frame 40-45, then stabilise.
findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze y drops steeply to its lowest point at frame ~40, coinciding with contact, then rises and steadies after.
findings.why_it_matters: Lifting or moving the head early can disturb balance and make the racket face less stable, affecting shuttle placement.
findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes level and steady through the hit—imagine watching the point of contact until the shuttle has left the strings.
findings.suggested_drill: Target-focus rally: pair up and rally only backhand drives while keeping your gaze fixed on a small mark on the opposite side of the net.

zh_Hant.name: 接觸時頭部抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線追蹤顯示在第40至45幀時有明顯的垂直和水平移動，然後穩定下來。

zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球過程中保持眼睛水平並穩定——想像自己注視著接觸點直到羽球離開球拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 目標專注的回合練習：兩人配對進行回合練習，只打反手平抽球，同時將視線固定在球網對面的一個小標記上。

zh_Hant.summary: 你的反手平抽球很穩定，但一些關鍵的時機和姿勢細節限制了力量和控制。影片顯示你的軀幹轉動幅度較小，擊球時手臂完全伸直，重心轉移發生在擊球之後，並且有短暫的抬頭動作。解決這些問題應該能幫助你更好地蓄力，更早地傳遞能量，並使球路更平、更準確。

confirmed_findings.name: Limited trunk rotation in preparation
confirmed_findings.details: From frames 0-27 your shoulders and hips stay almost square to the net while the racket arm moves back. The torso shows only a small coil.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton images at frames 0, 14 and 27 display modest change in shoulder/hip orientation; hips remain nearly parallel to the front.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A deeper shoulder-hip turn stores elastic energy and positions the racket for a shorter, faster forward swing—key for a powerful, quick backhand drive.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: During preparation, rotate your non-racket shoulder slightly forward and point your chest more towards the rear court before starting the forward swing.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Mirror shadow swings: face a mirror, exaggerate turning the torso so your back faces the net, then snap back to contact position while keeping feet stable.

zh_Hant.name: 準備動作中軀幹旋轉幅度有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第0到27幀之間，你的肩膀和臀部幾乎保持與球網平行，而球拍手臂向後移動。軀幹僅顯示出輕微的扭轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第0、14和27幀的骨架圖像中，肩膀和臀部的方向變化不大；臀部幾乎保持與前方平行。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的肩膀和臀部轉動可以儲存彈性能量，並將球拍置於更短、更快的前揮位置——這是實現強力快速反手平抽球的關鍵。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在準備動作中，稍微向前旋轉非持拍手的肩膀，並將胸部更多地指向後場，然後再開始前揮動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子影子揮拍練習：面對鏡子，誇張地轉動軀幹，讓背部面向球網，然後迅速回到擊球位置，同時保持雙腳穩定。

confirmed_findings.name: Elbow fully locked at contact
confirmed_findings.details: At frame 41 your racket arm is almost completely straight with the elbow locked out as you meet the shuttle.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: The contact-frame stick figure shows a straight line from shoulder through wrist, indicating minimal elbow flexion.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Locking the elbow reduces the wrist’s whipping action and makes timing harder, which can lead to reduced shuttle speed and limited directional control.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Aim to keep a slight bend in the elbow (about 15°) at contact, allowing the forearm and wrist to snap through.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Half-court wall drives: stand close to a wall and hit continuous backhand drives, focusing on a soft elbow and a late wrist snap.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘完全鎖死
zh_Hant.details: 在第41幀時，你的球拍手臂幾乎完全伸直，手肘在擊球時鎖死。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 擊球幀的骨架圖顯示從肩膀到手腕是一條直線，表明手肘幾乎沒有彎曲。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手肘鎖死會減少手腕的鞭打動作，並使時機更難掌握，這可能導致球速降低和方向控制受限。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時保持手肘略微彎曲（約15°），允許前臂和手腕完成鞭打動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 半場牆壁平抽練習：站在靠近牆壁的地方，連續進行反手平抽球，專注於保持手肘柔軟並在最後一刻進行手腕鞭打。

confirmed_findings.name: Weight shift happens after contact
confirmed_findings.details: Pressure on the front (receiving) foot rises notably only after frame ~50, several frames after the contact at frame 41.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Both left and right insole traces show low values through contact, then a clear surge beginning roughly 10 frames later.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Late weight transfer means the stroke relies on the arm rather than whole-body momentum, limiting drive speed and making recovery slower.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Start pushing off your rear foot just before the swing, so your weight is already moving forward at contact.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Step-in drive drill: from a neutral stance, step with the rear foot and drive the shuttle, aiming to land on the front foot exactly as the racket meets the shuttle.

zh_Hant.name: 重心轉移發生在擊球之後
zh_Hant.details: 在第50幀左右，前腳（接球腳）的壓力顯著增加，而這是在第41幀擊球後的幾幀才發生的。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 左右鞋墊的壓力數據顯示，在擊球時壓力值較低，然後在大約10幀後出現明顯的上升。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 重心轉移過晚意味著擊球主要依賴手臂而非全身動力，這會限制平抽球的速度並使回位速度變慢。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前稍微用後腳發力，這樣在擊球時你的重心已經開始向前移動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 跨步平抽練習：從中立站姿開始，用後腳跨步並進行平抽球，目標是在球拍擊中球的同時，前腳剛好落地。

confirmed_findings.name: Lower-body muscle activation lags upper-body
confirmed_findings.details: Upper-arm channels peak around frames 10-15 and again near 40, whereas major leg channels (Leg EMG 1 & 4) spike later, peaking around frames 55-65.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: EMG plots show distinct early peaks in upper EMG 1/2 before contact; leg EMG peaks are delayed until after contact.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: For an efficient kinetic chain, force should start from the legs and hips, then flow to the arm. A reverse order can strain the shoulder and decrease racket speed.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Focus on initiating the stroke by driving through your legs and hips first, letting that momentum carry into the arm swing.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Medicine-ball side throws on the backhand side: emphasise pushing from the legs and rotating the torso before the arms release the ball.

zh_Hant.name: 下肢肌肉的啟動滯後於上肢
zh_Hant.details: 上臂通道在第10至15幀以及接近第40幀時達到峰值，而主要腿部通道（腿部肌電圖1和4）則在稍後達到峰值，約在第55至65幀之間。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 肌電圖顯示上肢肌電圖1/2在接觸前有明顯的早期峰值；腿部肌電圖的峰值則延遲到接觸後才出現。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 為了達到高效的動力鏈，力量應從腿部和臀部開始，然後流向手臂。反向順序可能會使肩膀承受壓力並降低球拍速度。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 專注於通過腿部和臀部的推動來啟動擊球，讓這股動能傳遞到手臂揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 藥球反手側拋：強調從腿部推動並旋轉軀幹，然後手臂釋放球。

confirmed_findings.name: Head lifts during contact
confirmed_findings.details: Gaze traces show a sharp vertical and horizontal shift exactly at frame 40-45, then stabilise.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze y drops steeply to its lowest point at frame ~40, coinciding with contact, then rises and steadies after.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Lifting or moving the head early can disturb balance and make the racket face less stable, affecting shuttle placement.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes level and steady through the hit—imagine watching the point of contact until the shuttle has left the strings.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Target-focus rally: pair up and rally only backhand drives while keeping your gaze fixed on a small mark on the opposite side of the net.

zh_Hant.name: 接觸時頭部抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線追蹤顯示在第40至45幀時有明顯的垂直和水平移動，然後穩定下來。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛視線的Y軸在約第40幀時急劇下降至最低點，與接觸相吻合，然後上升並穩定。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早抬起或移動頭部可能會影響平衡，導致球拍面不穩定，影響羽球的落點。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球過程中保持眼睛水平並穩定——想像自己注視著接觸點直到羽球離開球拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 目標專注的回合練習：兩人配對進行回合練習，只打反手平抽球，同時將視線固定在球網對面的一個小標記上。

coaching_actions.cue: Load with a bigger shoulder-hip turn, then drive weight forward before contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Earlier body loading and timely weight transfer will let you generate power from the ground up instead of relying on the arm.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow + step-in sequence: slow-motion shadow 5 reps focusing on turn and push, then immediately hit 5 shuttle drives applying the same feeling.

zh_Hant.cue: 肩膀和臀部進行更大的轉動，然後在接觸前將重量向前推。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 提前進行身體負重和及時的重量轉移，能讓你從地面產生力量，而不是依賴手臂。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子+步入序列：慢動作影子練習5次，專注於轉身和推動，然後立即擊打5次羽球平抽球，應用相同的感覺。

coaching_actions.cue: Maintain a slight elbow bend at impact and finish the shot with a quick wrist snap.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A relaxed elbow improves racket-head speed and directional control.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Wall-drive sets of 30 seconds, counting only drives where you feel the elbow stay soft at contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球時保持輕微的肘部彎曲，並以快速的手腕甩動完成擊球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 放鬆的肘部能提高球拍頭速度和方向控制。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 牆壁平抽球練習30秒，只計算在接觸時感覺肘部保持放鬆的擊球。

coaching_actions.cue: Keep your head still through contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Stable vision supports balance and consistent racket face.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Video yourself hitting 10 drives while focusing on a fixed spot; review to ensure minimal head movement.

zh_Hant.cue: 在接觸時保持頭部穩定。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 穩定的視線有助於平衡和球拍面的一致性。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 錄製自己擊打10次平抽球，同時專注於固定的點；回看影片以確保頭部移動最小化。
